title_zh: 陈绮贞：台湾独立音乐的温柔声音
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (6/20): Cheer Chen, the Gentle Voice of Taiwanese Indie
note_en: 只有……才…… means "only if... then...": 只有坚持自己独立的风格，才能做出真正打动人的音乐 "only by staying true to her own style can she make music that truly moves people." The 只有 clause states the one necessary condition, and 才 must appear before the verb of the result. Don't confuse it with 只要……就…… "as long as..., then...," which states a sufficient condition.
